question: Should OpenClaw accept first-party Control UI math rendering in this PR, and if so what dependency/vendor and delimiter policy should it use?
rationale: The change is useful, but it adds core UI rendering behavior plus same-origin third-party code and ambiguous delimiter parsing that automation should not accept without maintainer direction.

options.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
options.body: Use a reviewed package/build or approved vendor process and avoid `$...$` as default inline math unless maintainers explicitly accept the compatibility change.

options.title: Accept owner-approved vendoring
options.body: Maintainers can accept a bundled MathJax asset only with documented source, version, license, update process, and security review provenance.

options.title: Defer this PR
options.body: Pause or close this candidate and converge the canonical math-rendering issue through another implementation with stronger proof and dependency handling.

recommendation.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
recommendation.body: Use a reviewed package/build or approved vendor process and avoid `$...$` as default inline math unless maintainers explicitly accept the compatibility change.

likelyOwner.reason: He has original Control UI chat markdown history and is the strongest available routing candidate for the product/default behavior decision.
